source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.8.1, printed page 15.

blocks.text: Pani ke saath sodium magnesium se zyada reactive hai. Sodium pani se zor se (vigorously) react kar ke sodium hydroxide aur hydrogen banata hai, jab ke magnesium aahista react kar ke magnesium hydroxide aur hydrogen banata hai. Lekin magnesium bhaap (steam) ke saath zyada tezi se react kar ke magnesium oxide aur hydrogen gas banata hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Equations mein (s) = solid, (l) = liquid, (g) = gas aur (aq) = pani mein hal (aqueous). Pehli do equations mein H₂O(l) yani pani hai, teesri mein H₂O(g) yani bhaap. Magnesium hydroxide pani mein bohat kam hal hota hai, is liye kai kitabein ise Mg(OH)₂(s) likhti hain.

blocks.prompt: Magnesium bhaap ke saath oxide aur thande pani ke saath hydroxide kyun deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Thande pani ke saath sust reaction mein magnesium hydroxide banta hai. Bhaap ke zyada temperature par reaction bohat tez hai aur hydroxide qaim nahi rehta, is liye product magnesium oxide aur hydrogen hain.

items: Sodium + pani: zor se, NaOH aur H₂. Magnesium + pani: aahista, Mg(OH)₂ aur H₂. Magnesium + bhaap: tezi se, MgO aur H₂.
